name: Woven Sanal POS for WooCommerce
author: Woven Teknoloji LTD ŞTİ

sections.description:
Woven Sanal POS for WooCommerce lets your store accept credit and debit card payments through the NestPay/EstPos virtual POS platform used by many Turkish banks. It uses the 3D Pay Hosting model, so authentication and payment complete in a single step and no separate provision call is required.

The gateway is compatible with banks running on NestPay/EstPos, including Halkbank, Isbank, Ziraat Bank, Sekerbank and QNB Finansbank. Because the endpoint URLs and store credentials are entered in the settings, the plugin can be adapted to a different bank without code changes.

Features:

  • 3D Pay Hosting checkout with ver3 SHA-512 hashing.
  • Integrity verification of the HASH returned by the bank.
  • Configurable 3D acceptance level (full authentication only, or partial as well).
  • Refunds (Credit) and voids from within WooCommerce.
  • Compatible with High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS).
  • Optional debug logging.

The admin interface is provided in Turkish and is fully translatable through the included translation template.

External services

This plugin connects to the bank virtual POS server configured by the store administrator in order to process card payments. By default the Halkbank virtual POS endpoints are configured, and they can be changed by the administrator to another NestPay/EstPos bank or to a test environment.

  • During checkout (3D Pay Hosting), the customer is redirected to the bank 3D payment page with the order number and amount. Default endpoint: https://sanalpos.halkbank.com.tr/fim/est3Dgate
  • For refunds and voids, the merchant number, API credentials, order number and amount are sent to the bank API endpoint. Default endpoint: https://sanalpos.halkbank.com.tr/fim/api

The data sent is used only to complete the corresponding payment, refund or void request. The terms of use and privacy policy of the endpoint belong to the respective bank.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to the /wp-content/plugins/woven-sanal-pos-for-woocommerce directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress (WooCommerce must be installed).
  3. Go to WooCommerce > Settings > Payments > Woven Sanal POS.
  4. Enter the merchant number (clientid) and store key provided by your bank.
  5. For refunds and voids, enter the API user name and password created in your bank panel.
  6. Make sure the 3D model type in your bank panel is set to 3D Pay Hosting.
sections.faq:
Which banks are supported?

Any bank running on the NestPay/EstPos platform. Halkbank endpoints are configured by default; for other banks, just change the endpoint URLs in the settings.

How do I test it?

Enter the test (integration) endpoint provided by your bank into the 3D Gateway URL and API URL fields in the settings.

Why are refunds not working?

Refunds and voids require an API user name and password, created with the API user role in your bank panel, to be set in the settings.
